summary_1line: Hanuman, hiding in a tree near Sita, recounts Rama’s lineage, exile, and quest to reassure her and reveal himself safely.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman sits hidden among the branches of a Shingshapa tree, gently speaking Rama’s story to the sorrowful Sita below.
Sita, her tangled hair falling aside, looks up in astonishment toward the tree after hearing a monkey recite Rama’s deeds.
